page.layout: One printed page, no text blocks. Only faint show-through from the reverse side: mirrored title lines at the top, a mirrored block of lines in the upper middle, and a faint ornament or device in the centre-lower area. No running head, page number or signature.
page.notes: The page is blank apart from show-through.
